items.heading: Start with Two Salary Guides
items.text: Start with two salary guides published in 2026. One covers software engineers and one covers data scientists, so the stages do not line up perfectly.

items.heading: Ambitionbox Publishes Ranges Built From
items.text: AmbitionBox publishes ranges built from salaries people report about their own jobs. These figures give a second view.

items.heading: The Same Title Pays Very
items.text: The same title pays very differently depending on who hires you. This is where the real gap sits, and it is why a high-value skill portfolio that gets you into a better employer type matters more than the label.
